resources.string: Applies to this installation only. The current work mode stays the same.
The device works in this mode after migrating.

How it works: patches the kernel to provide SU. With no modules installed: 0 visible SELinux policy changes, 0 mounts and SELinux globally Enforcing, eliminating side-channel signatures from policy changes and mounts at the kernel level.
Modules: supports all MapleSU modules and a subset of KernelSU modules that require no injection.
Best for: geeks and users who care about a clean environment.
How it works: built on KernelSU, with high compatibility.
Modules: integrates with the KSU module ecosystem; Ultra native modules run in Ultra mode.
